about.title: About Inflation Calculator - Purchasing Power and Price Change Tool
about.description: The Inflation Calculator is a comprehensive economic analysis tool designed to help you understand how inflation affects purchasing power and money value over time. This calculator shows how much goods and services that cost a certain amount in the past would cost today, or how much today's money will be worth in the future. Whether you're planning retirement, analyzing investments, or understanding economic trends, this tool provides accurate inflation-adjusted calculations.

faq.q: What is inflation and how is it measured?
faq.a: Inflation is the rate at which prices for goods and services rise over time, reducing purchasing power. It's measured using the Consumer Price Index (CPI), which tracks price changes in a basket of common goods and services.

Historical inflation calculations are very accurate using official CPI data. Future projections use average rates or Federal Reserve targets (typically 2%) but actual future inflation may vary significantly from projections.

faq.q: Why is understanding inflation important for investing?
faq.a: Inflation erodes purchasing power, so investments must earn returns above the inflation rate to maintain real value. A 5% return with 3% inflation only provides 2% real growth in purchasing power.

Inflation is influenced by monetary policy, supply and demand imbalances, energy prices, wage growth, government spending, and global economic conditions. Central banks use interest rates to manage inflation levels.
